Intercontinental Exchange and Trade[XYZ] to Bring Hyperliquid-Based Perpetual Markets Onshore. Learn more.

Wet Freight

When geopolitics impacts trade routes, freight becomes one of the most important markets in the world.

Explore now

Data, technology and expertise that inspire innovation and create opportunity.

Exchanges and Clearing

Transforming what's possible

We were the first to digitize exchanges, and continue to be a leader on price discovery, capital raising, indexing, Clearing and more.

Learn more
Fixed Income and Data Services

Streamlining the system

Extensive, high quality and market-leading data. Our end-to-end solutions help deliver the insights that drive decision-making.

Learn more
Mortgage Technology

Automating the industry

We're digitizing the entire mortgage process to reduce cost and increase efficiencies.

Learn more

Energy

Energy products on a global scale

The benchmark prices for the world's most important commodities - oil, natural gas, environmentals, power and coal - are formed every day on our markets.

Explore energy markets

Insights from ICE

Mortgage

ARM Demand Hits Nearly Four-Year High on Rising Mortgage Rates

“ARMs are becoming more attractive to borrowers looking for relief from today’s higher fixed rates, but the overall market exposure to adjustable payments remains relatively limited,” said Andy Walden, head of Mortgage and Housing Market Research at ICE.

Learn more ›
